data.description: Corner Unit | Best Layout | Dual View
data.display_address: Sobha Creek Vistas Grande, sobha_hartland, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Presenting this exceptional corner unit 2-bedroom apartment in Sobha Creek Vistas Grande, offering one of the best and most spacious 2-bedroom layouts in the development. With a total area of 1,240.54 sq.ft, this residence combines intelligent design, privacy, and breathtaking views.

The apartment features two master bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, plus an additional guest bathroom, making it ideal for families or professionals seeking space and comfort. The semi-closed kitchen is fully fitted and equipped, seamlessly blending functionality with modern finishes.

Large windows throughout the unit allow abundant natural light and showcase dual views, including the Downtown Dubai skyline on one side and serene community views on the other an exclusive benefit of this corner positioning.

Property Features:

Corner unit
Best 2-bedroom layout
2 master bedrooms
3 bathrooms (2 en-suite)
Built-up area: 1,240.54 sq.ft
Semi-closed kitchen
Fully fitted & equipped kitchen
Dual views
Downtown skyline view
Community view

Located in a prestigious Sobha development, residents enjoy a refined lifestyle with high-quality finishes, well-maintained surroundings, and excellent connectivity to key destinations across Dubai.

An ideal home for end-users seeking space and views, or investors looking for a high-demand unit in a premium community.
